changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Create the explicit self-punch permission for subscribed Attendance tenants that previously depended on backend role or employee-directory fallbacks.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO "${schema}".permission ( id, resource, action, module_id, description ) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'attendance', 'punch_self', module.id, 'Live punch in/out and own punch-day summary' FROM kabipay_ops.module AS module WHERE module.code = 'ATTENDANCE' AND module.is_active = true AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kabipay_ops.tenant_subscription AS subscription JOIN "${schema}".role AS tenant_role ON tenant_role.tenant_id = subscription.tenant_id WHERE subscription.module_id = module.id AND subscription.status = 'ACTIVE' AND subscription.is_deleted = false ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "${schema}".permission AS existing_permission WHERE existing_permission.resource = 'attendance' AND existing_permission.action = 'punch_self' AND existing_permission.module_id = module.id );

changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Preserve effective self-punch access by converting legacy administrator-role and employee-directory fallbacks into explicit role permissions. Rollback intentionally does not revoke authorization because a mapping may predate this migration or be approved later.
changeSet.sql: WITH punch_permission AS ( SELECT permission.id FROM "${schema}".permission AS permission JOIN kabipay_ops.module AS module ON module.id = permission.module_id WHERE permission.resource = 'attendance' AND permission.action = 'punch_self' AND module.code = 'ATTENDANCE' ) INSERT INTO "${schema}".role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT DISTINCT tenant_role.id, punch_permission.id FROM "${schema}".role AS tenant_role CROSS JOIN punch_permission WHERE tenant_role.is_deleted = false AND ( UPPER(TRIM(tenant_role.name)) IN ('HR_ADMIN', 'TENANT_ADMIN', 'ORG_ADMIN') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "${schema}".role_permission AS existing_role_permission JOIN "${schema}".permission AS existing_permission ON existing_permission.id = existing_role_permission.permission_id WHERE existing_role_permission.role_id = tenant_role.id AND existing_permission.resource = 'employee' AND existing_permission.action IN ('write', 'manage') ) ) ON CONFLICT (role_id, permission_id) DO NOTHING;
